insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (depends on Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: (h) Reload of Sum Insured: Once in the Policy Year, We shall provide for a reload of the Sum Insured up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, in case the available Sum Insured... is insufficient for covering a claim under the Policy as a result of previous claims in that Policy Year.
great.reference: Section C.I.(h) Reload of Sum Insured
great.explanation: The policy provides a reload of the sum insured once per policy year if the base sum insured is exhausted due to earlier claims. This gives you extra coverage for subsequent claims within the same policy year.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with Insurer.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 24 months from policy start. After 24 months of continuous coverage, these conditions are covered.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the ﬁrst policy with us.
good.reference: Section D.I.2 (Standard Exclusions) - Specified disease / procedure waiting period (Code-Excl02)
good.explanation: Certain listed illnesses and procedures are excluded for 24 months from policy start. After this period, treatment for these conditions is covered.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the ﬁrst policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered.
good.explanation: Illnesses are not covered during the first 30 days of the policy, but accidents are covered from day one. This is a standard waiting period.

good.name: Restore Benefit
good.quote: Such reloading of Sum Insured shall be available only once during a Policy Year... The reload of Sum Insured shall not apply to the ﬁrst claim in the Policy Year... available only for subsequent claims and not in relation to any Illness/ Injury (including its complications) for which a claim has been admitted for the Insured Person during that Policy Year.
good.reference: Section C.I.(h) Reload of Sum Insured - Conditions (ii) and (iii)
good.explanation: The sum insured reload is available once per year but only for unrelated illnesses and not for the same illness in the same policy year. This is a standard restore benefit.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent for accommodation in Hospital room and other boarding charges up to the limits as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy;
bad.reference: Section C.I.(a) In-patient Hospitalization - What is covered (1)
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped as per your plan’s schedule and is not unlimited. This can reduce your claim payout if you choose a higher room category.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is speciﬁed... then the Insured Person shall bear a rateable proportion of the total Associated Medical Expenses... in the proportion of the difference between the Room Rent of the entitled room category to the Room Rent actually incurred.
bad.explanation: If you stay in a room higher than your eligibility, the insurer reduces many related costs proportionately, increasing your out-of-pocket expenses.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Activ Care Policy Wordings - Annexure - I - List of Non-medical expenses... 56 GLOVES ... 60 MASK ... 58 ANY KIT WITH NO DETAILS MENTIONED [DELIVERY KIT, ORTHOKIT, RECOVERY KIT, ETC]
bad.reference: Annexure I - List of Non-medical expenses
bad.explanation: Many common hospital consumables like gloves, masks, and kits are excluded from coverage, so you will have to pay for these out-of-pocket.

bad.name: Disease Sub-limits
bad.quote: (j) Sublimit for listed illnesses: We will cover the Medical Expenses arising out of an Insured Person’s in-patient Hospitalization for the listed Illness/ conditions and limit as speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table.
bad.reference: Section C.I.(j) Sublimit for listed illnesses
bad.explanation: The policy imposes sub-limits on certain illnesses as per the schedule, which can limit your claim amount compared to the full sum insured.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus
bad.quote: In the event of a claim impacting the eligibility of a No Claim Bonus, the accumulated No Claim Bonus shall be reduced by 10% of the Sum Insured at the commencement of subsequent Policy Year.
bad.explanation: The no claim bonus reduces by 10% after a claim instead of being fully protected, which means you lose part of your bonus on claims.

unclear.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We shall cover on a reimbursement basis, in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, the Insured Person’s Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.reference: Section C.I.(b) Pre – hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.explanation: The duration of pre-hospitalization coverage is not specified in the wording and depends on the policy schedule. Confirm the exact number of days.

unclear.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
unclear.quote: We shall cover on a reimbursement basis, in accordance with the limits speciﬁed in the Policy Schedule / Product Beneﬁt Table of this Policy, the Insured Person’s Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.reference: Section C.I.(c) Post – hospitalization Medical Expenses
unclear.explanation: The duration of post-hospitalization coverage is not specified in the wording and depends on the policy schedule. Confirm the exact number of days.
